verses.sloka: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सुमाली नाम राक्षसः ।रसातलान्मर्त्यलोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ।। ७.९.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ ।rasātalānmartyalokaṁ sarvaṁ vai vicacāra ha ।। 7.9.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, a demon named Sumali wandered throughout the entire mortal world, having come from Rasatala.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड दा सातवाँ सगं समाप्त हुआ | क्न & SO ये हन्यसाने बले तस्मिन्‌ प्ननांभेन पृष्ठतः । माल्यवान्‌ सन्निदृ्तोऽथ वेलामेत्य इबाण वः

verses.sloka: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः ।कन्यां दुहितरं गृह्य विना पद्ममिव श्रियम् ।। ७.९.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ ।kanyāṁ duhitaraṁ gṛhya vinā padmamiva śriyam ।। 7.9.2 ॥

translations.english: He, resembling a dark cloud and adorned with earrings of molten gold, took his daughter, who was as beautiful as Lakshmi without her lotus.
translations.hindi: साल्यवान राक्षस क्रोध में भर तथा लाल लाल नेत्र कर और सिर कँपाता हुआ भगवान्‌ पुरुषोत्तम पद्मनाभ से यह बोला

verses.sloka: राक्षसेन्द्रः स तु तदा विचरन्वै महीतलम् ।तदापश्यत्स गच्छन्तं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरम् ।। ७.९.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasendraḥ sa tu tadā vicaranvai mahītalam ।tadāpaśyatsa gacchantaṁ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaram ।। 7.9.3 ॥

translations.english: While the king of demons was wandering on the surface of the earth, he then saw Kubera, the lord of wealth, traveling in the Pushpaka chariot.
translations.hindi: हे नारायण ? तुम पुरातन ज्ञात्रधम को नहीं जानते । क्योंकि युद्ध से लौटे हुए और डरे हुए हम लोगों को तुम क्लुद्रजन की तरह मार रहें हो

verses.sloka: गच्छन्तं पितरं द्रष्टुं पुलस्त्यतनयं विभुम् ।तं दृष्ट्वा ऽमरसङ्काशं स्वच्छन्दं तपनोपमम् ।। ७.९.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: gacchantaṁ pitaraṁ draṣṭuṁ pulastyatanayaṁ vibhum ।taṁ dṛṣṭvā 'marasaṅkāśaṁ svacchandaṁ tapanopamam ।। 7.9.4 ॥

translations.english: Having seen him, the powerful son of Pulastya (Kubera), who was going to see his father, resembling an immortal, moving freely, and radiant like the sun.
translations.hindi: हुँ सुरेश्वर ! युद्ध से सुख मोड़े हुए को जो मारता है, वह पाप करता है । उसे पुण्यात्मा लोगों से प्राप्त स्वगे की प्राप्ति नहीं होती

verses.sloka: रसातलं प्रविष्टः सन्मर्त्यलोकात्सविस्मयः ।इत्येवं चिन्तयामास राक्षसानां महामतिः ।। ७.९.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṁ praviṣṭaḥ sanmartyalokātsavismayaḥ ।ityevaṁ cintayāmāsa rākṣasānāṁ mahāmatiḥ ।। 7.9.5 ॥

translations.english: Having returned to Rasatala from the mortal world, the great-minded Sumali, filled with wonder, began to ponder in this manner.
translations.hindi: हँ शङ्क-चक्र-गदा-धारी ! यदि तेरी इच्छा लड़ने ही को हे तो मैं तेरे सामने खड़ा हूँ | सक पर तू आपना बल का प्रयोग करले

verses.sloka: किं कृतं श्रेय इत्येवं वर्धेमहि कथं वयम् ।अथाब्रवीत्सुतां रक्षः कैकसीं नाम नामतः ।। ७.९.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ kṛtaṁ śreya ityevaṁ vardhemahi kathaṁ vayam ।athābravītsutāṁ rakṣaḥ kaikasīṁ nāma nāmataḥ ।। 7.9.6 ॥

translations.english: The Rakshasa then spoke to his daughter, Kaikasi by name, pondering how they might prosper and what good they should do.
translations.hindi: माल्यवान पवेत की तरह माल्यवान राक्षस को खड़ा देख, उस राक्षसेन्द्र से भगवान्‌ विष्णु ने कहा

verses.sloka: पुत्रि प्रदानकालो ऽयं यौवनं व्यतिवर्तते ।प्रत्याख्यानाच्च भीतैस्त्वं न वरैः प्रतिगृह्यसे ।। ७.९.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: putri pradānakālo 'yaṁ yauvanaṁ vyativartate ।pratyākhyānācca bhītaistvaṁ na varaiḥ pratigṛhyase ।। 7.9.7 ॥

translations.english: O daughter, this is the time for your marriage, and your youth is passing; you are not being accepted by suitors, who are afraid of rejection.
translations.hindi: तुम लोगों के भय से त्रस्त देवताओं को, मैंने राक्षसनाश- रूप अभयदान दिआ हे, सो में इस समय राक्षसों का विनाश कर, उस अपनी प्रतिज्ञा को पूर्ण कर रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: त्वत्कृते च वयं सर्वे यन्त्रिता धर्मबुद्धयः ।त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके ।कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।। ७.९.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvatkṛte ca vayaṁ sarve yantritā dharmabuddhayaḥ ।tvaṁ hi sarvaguṇopetā śrīḥ sākṣādiva putrike ।kanyāpitṛtvaṁ duḥkhaṁ hi sarveṣāṁ mānakāṅkṣiṇām ।। 7.9.8 ॥

translations.english: For your sake, all of us, though righteous-minded, are troubled, for you, O daughter, are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

verses.sloka: न ज्ञायते च कः कन्यां वरयेदिति कन्यके ।। ७.९.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: na jñāyate ca kaḥ kanyāṁ varayediti kanyake ।। 7.9.9 ॥

translations.english: And it is not known, O daughter, who would choose to marry such a maiden.

verses.sloka: त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके । मातुः कुलं पितृकुलं यत्र चैव प्रदीयते ।कुलत्रयं सदा कन्या संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति ।। ७.९.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ hi sarvaguṇopetā śrīḥ sākṣādiva putrike । mātuḥ kulaṁ pitṛkulaṁ yatra caiva pradīyate ।kulatrayaṁ sadā kanyā saṁśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati ।। 7.9.10 ॥

translations.english: O daughter, you are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; a daughter always keeps three families—her mother's, her father's, and the one to which she is given—in a state of uncertainty.
translations.hindi: साल्यवान के हाथ से छूटी हुई बह्‌ शक्ति घंटियों का शब्द्‌ करती हुई, भगवान्‌ विष्णु की छाती में लग ऐसी शोभित हुई, जेसे श्यामसेघ में बिजुली शोभित होती है

verses.sloka: सा त्वं मुनिवरं श्रेष्ठं प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम् ।भज विश्रवसं पुत्रि पौलस्त्यं वरय स्वयम् ।। ७.९.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvaṁ munivaraṁ śreṣṭhaṁ prajāpatikulodbhavam ।bhaja viśravasaṁ putri paulastyaṁ varaya svayam ।। 7.9.11 ॥

translations.english: O daughter, you yourself should choose and resort to Vishravas, the excellent and best of sages, born in the lineage of Prajapati and son of Pulastya.

verses.sloka: ईदृशास्ते भविष्यन्ति पुत्राः पुत्रि न संशयः ।तेजसा भास्करसमो यादृशो ऽयं धनेश्वरः ।। ७.९.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśāste bhaviṣyanti putrāḥ putri na saṁśayaḥ ।tejasā bhāskarasamo yādṛśo 'yaṁ dhaneśvaraḥ ।। 7.9.12 ॥

translations.english: O daughter, without a doubt, your sons will be like this lord of wealth (Kubera), equal to the sun in splendor.
translations.hindi: यु शं [oS Cae ~ स्न्दोतसुष्टेव सा शक्तिगोविंदकरनिःसृता । काङ्चन्ती राक्षसं प्रायान्‌ महोल्केवाञ्जनाचलम्‌ ॥१२, भगवान्‌ गोविन्द के हाथ से छूटी हुईं बह शक्ति स्वामि कातिक के समान राक्षस का संहार करने के लिए ऐसी लपकी, मानों कञजलगिरि पर उल्का कपट कर आइ हो

verses.sloka: सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्यका पितृगौरवात् ।तत्रोपागम्य सा तस्थौ विश्रवा यत्र तप्यते ।। ७.९.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā tu tadvacanaṁ śrutvā kanyakā pitṛgauravāt ।tatropāgamya sā tasthau viśravā yatra tapyate ।। 7.9.13 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that instruction, the maiden, out of respect for her father, approached the place where Vishravas was performing penance and stood there.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम पुलस्त्यतनयो द्विजः ।अग्निहोत्रमुपातिष्ठच्चतुर्थ इव पावकः ।। ७.९.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare rāma pulastyatanayo dvijaḥ ।agnihotramupātiṣṭhaccaturtha iva pāvakaḥ ।। 7.9.14 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, in the meantime, the brahmin Vishravas, son of Pulastya, performed the Agnihotra ritual, appearing like a fourth sacred fire himself.
translations.hindi: उस शक्ति के लगने से माल्यवान का कबच टूट गया ओर >>> टर सचे बह मूछित हो गया । कुछ काल पीछे बह सचेत हि हुआ । वह फिर पबत की तरह निश्चल हो सामने खड़ा हो गया

verses.sloka: अविचिन्त्य तु तां वेलां दारुणां पितृगौरवात् ।उपसृत्याग्रतस्तस्य चरणाधोमुखी स्थिता ।विलिखन्ती मुहुर्भूमिमङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण भामिनी ।। ७.९.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: avicintya tu tāṁ velāṁ dāruṇāṁ pitṛgauravāt ।upasṛtyāgratastasya caraṇādhomukhī sthitā ।vilikhantī muhurbhūmimaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa bhāminī ।। 7.9.15 ॥

translations.english: Disregarding that dreadful time, out of respect for her father, the beautiful maiden approached and stood before him, her face bowed towards his feet, repeatedly scratching the ground with the tip of her big toe.

verses.sloka: स तु तां वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् ।अब्रवीत्परमोदारो दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा ।। ७.९.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu tāṁ vīkṣya suśroṇīṁ pūrṇacandranibhānanām ।abravītparamodāro dīpyamānāṁ svatejasā ।। 7.9.16 ॥

translations.english: The exceedingly noble sage, having seen her, who had beautiful hips, a face like the full moon, and was shining with her own radiance, spoke to her.
translations.hindi: गरुङ जी के पंखों के पवन से अपने बड़े भाई माल्यवान को भगाया हुआ देख, सुमाली अपनी सेना को साथ ते लक्का को भाग गया

verses.sloka: भद्रे कस्यासि दुहिता कुतो वा त्वमिहागता ।किं कार्यं कस्य वा हेतोस्तत्त्वतो ब्रूहि शोभने ।। ७.९.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhadre kasyāsi duhitā kuto vā tvamihāgatā ।kiṁ kāryaṁ kasya vā hetostattvato brūhi śobhane ।। 7.9.17 ॥

translations.english: O gentle lady, whose daughter are you, and from where have you come here; O beautiful one, tell me truly what your purpose is or for what reason you are here.
translations.hindi: उसका ऐसा साहस देख कर आकाश में “बाह बाह” का | बड़ा शब्द हुआ अर्थांत. सुन पडा । साल्यवान्‌ ने भगवान्‌ | बिष्णु पर प्रहार कर गरुड जी पर भी प्रहार किआ

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या कृताञ्जलिरथाब्रवीत् ।आत्मप्रभावेण मुने ज्ञातुमर्हसि मे मतम् ।। ७.९.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu sā kanyā kṛtāñjalirathābravīt ।ātmaprabhāveṇa mune jñātumarhasi me matam ।। 7.9.18 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, the maiden, having folded her hands, then spoke, saying, "O sage, you are capable of knowing my intention by your own spiritual power."
translations.hindi: तब बलवान, गरुड जी ने क्रोध में भर, उस राक्षस को वहाँ से अपने पंखों के पवन के भोंकों से ऐसा उड़ाया; जैसे पवन सूखे पत्तों के ढेर को सहज से उड़ा देता है

verses.sloka: किं तु मां विद्धि ब्रह्मर्षे शासनात्पितुरागताम् ।कैकसी नाम नाम्नाहं शेषं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। ७.९.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ tu māṁ viddhi brahmarṣe śāsanātpiturāgatām ।kaikasī nāma nāmnāhaṁ śeṣaṁ tvaṁ jñātumarhasi ।। 7.9.19 ॥

translations.english: "But know me, O Brahmarshi, as one who has come by the command of my father; I am named Kaikasi by name, and you are capable of knowing the rest."

verses.sloka: स तु गत्वा मुनिर्ध्यानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।विज्ञातं ते मया भद्रे कारणं यन्मनोगतम् ।। ७.९.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu gatvā munirdhyānaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।vijñātaṁ te mayā bhadre kāraṇaṁ yanmanogatam ।। 7.9.20 ॥

translations.english: The sage, having then entered into meditation, spoke these words: "O gentle lady, the reason that was in your mind has been known by me."
translations.hindi: गरुड जी के पंखों के पचन से उड़ाया हुआ राक्षस माल वान भी लज्जित हो, अपनी सेना को साथ लिए हुए लंड्का में लौट कर चला गया

verses.sloka: सुताभिलाषो मत्तस्ते मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि ।दारुणायां तु वेलायां यस्मात्त्वं मामुपस्थिता ।। ७.९.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sutābhilāṣo mattaste mattamātaṅgagāmini ।dāruṇāyāṁ tu velāyāṁ yasmāttvaṁ māmupasthitā ।। 7.9.21 ॥

translations.english: O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, since you have approached me at this dreadful time with a desire for a son from me.

verses.sloka: शृणु तस्मात्सुतान्भद्रे यादृशाञ्जनयिष्यसि ।दारुणान्दारुणाकारान्दारुणाभिजनप्रियान् ।। ७.९.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu tasmātsutānbhadre yādṛśāñjanayiṣyasi ।dāruṇāndāruṇākārāndāruṇābhijanapriyān ।। 7.9.22 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O auspicious one, listen to the kind of sons you will give birth to: they will be terrible, of dreadful appearance, and fond of cruel deeds.

verses.sloka: प्रसविष्यसि सुश्रोणि राक्षसान्क्रूरकर्मणः ।सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रणिपत्याब्रवीद्वचः ।। ७.९.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prasaviṣyasi suśroṇi rākṣasānkrūrakarmaṇaḥ ।sā tu tadvacanaṁ śrutvā praṇipatyābravīdvacaḥ ।। 7.9.23 ॥

translations.english: O lady with beautiful hips, you will give birth to Rakshasas who perform cruel deeds; but she, having heard his words, bowed down and spoke.
translations.hindi: हे रघुश्रेष्ठ ! समस्त प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी राक्षस, सुमाली को राजा बना, वहीं सालकटंकटा के वंश में रहने लगे । अथवा विख्यात बलवीय वाले राक्षस, सालकटंकटा के बंश चाले सुमाली के आश्रय में समय बिताने लगे

verses.sloka: भगवन्नीदृशान्पुत्रांस्त्वत्तो ऽहं ब्रह्मवादिनः ।नेच्छामि सुदुराचारान्प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ७.९.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavannīdṛśānputrāṁstvatto 'haṁ brahmavādinaḥ ।necchāmi sudurācārānprasādaṁ kartumarhasi ।। 7.9.24 ॥

translations.english: O venerable one, O speaker of Brahman, I do not desire such extremely ill-behaved sons from you; please show me your grace.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! तुमने पुलस्त्य बंश वाले जिन समस्त राक्षसों. का संहार किया है उन सब से महाभाग सुमाली, माल्यवान अर माली प्रधान थे। अधिक क्या कहैं -ये सब रावण से भी अधिक बलवान थे

verses.sloka: कन्यया त्वेवमुक्तस्तु विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।उवाच कैकसीं भूयः पूर्णेन्दुरिव रोहिणीम् ।। ७.९.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kanyayā tvevamuktastu viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ ।uvāca kaikasīṁ bhūyaḥ pūrṇenduriva rohiṇīm ।। 7.9.25 ॥

translations.english: But Vishrava, the foremost among sages, thus spoken to by the maiden, spoke again to Kaikasi, just as the full moon speaks to Rohini.

verses.sloka: पश्चिमो यस्तव सुतो भविष्यति शुभानने ।मम वंशानुरूपः स धर्मात्मा च भविष्यति ।। ७.९.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: paścimo yastava suto bhaviṣyati śubhānane ।mama vaṁśānurūpaḥ sa dharmātmā ca bhaviṣyati ।। 7.9.26 ॥

translations.english: O fair-faced one, your last son will be worthy of my lineage and will be righteous.
translations.hindi: सो तुम ही चार भुजाओं वाले, सनातन, अजेय, अविनाशी आर साक्षात्‌ नारायण हो | राक्षसों का नाश करने के लिए तुमने अवतार लिआ है

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या राम कालेन केनचित् ।जनयामास बीभत्सं रक्षोरूपं सुदारुणम् ।। ७.९.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu sā kanyā rāma kālena kenacit ।janayāmāsa bībhatsaṁ rakṣorūpaṁ sudāruṇam ।। 7.9.27 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, that maiden, thus addressed, after some time gave birth to a repulsive and very terrible Rakshasa-shaped child.
translations.hindi: जब कभी धर्म की अव्यवस्था होती हे, .तब आप उसकी सुव्यस्था करने तथा प्रजा की रक्षा के लिए तथा डाकुओं को मारने के लिए शरणागतवत्सलतावश जन्म लेते हैं

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवं महादंष्ट्रं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् ।ताम्रोष्ठं विंशतिभुजं महास्यं दीप्तमूर्धजम् ।। ७.९.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvaṁ mahādaṁṣṭraṁ nīlāñjanacayopamam ।tāmroṣṭhaṁ viṁśatibhujaṁ mahāsyaṁ dīptamūrdhajam ।। 7.9.28 ॥

translations.english: The child had ten necks, great fangs, resembled a heap of blue collyrium, possessed copper-red lips, twenty arms, a huge mouth, and blazing hair.
translations.hindi: हे नरनाथ ! आज सेने तुसको समस्त राक्तसों की उत्पत्ति की कथा ज्यो की त्यों सुनाई। हे रघुप्रेष्ठ ! अब में तुमको रावण आर उसके पुत्रो का जन्सवृत्तात एन अतुल प्रभाव का समस्त वृत्तांत सुनाता हूँ

verses.sloka: तस्मिञ्जाते तु तत्काले सज्वालकवलाः शिवाः ।क्रव्यादाश्चापसव्यानि मण्डलानि प्रचक्रमुः ।। ७.९.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmiñjāte tu tatkāle sajvālakavalāḥ śivāḥ ।kravyādāścāpasavyāni maṇḍalāni pracakramuḥ ।। 7.9.29 ॥

translations.english: At the very moment of his birth, jackals with flaming mouths and other carnivorous animals moved in inauspicious anti-clockwise circles.

verses.sloka: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो मेघाश्च खरनिःस्वनाः ।प्रबभौ न च सूर्यो वै महोल्काश्चापतन्भुवि ।। ७.९.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devo meghāśca kharaniḥsvanāḥ ।prababhau na ca sūryo vai maholkāścāpatanbhuvi ।। 7.9.30 ॥

translations.english: The sky rained blood, clouds roared harshly, the sun did not shine, and great meteors fell upon the earth.

verses.sloka: चकम्पे जगती चैव ववुर्वाताः सुदारुणाः ।अक्षोभ्यः क्षुभितश्चैव समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।। ७.९.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakampe jagatī caiva vavurvātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ।akṣobhyaḥ kṣubhitaścaiva samudraḥ saritāṁ patiḥ ।। 7.9.31 ॥

translations.english: The earth trembled, very fierce winds blew, and even the unshakeable ocean, the lord of rivers, became agitated.

verses.sloka: अथ नामाकरोत्तस्य पितामहसमः पिता ।दशग्रीवः प्रसूतो ऽयं दशग्रीवो भविष्यति ।। ७.९.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha nāmākarottasya pitāmahasamaḥ pitā ।daśagrīvaḥ prasūto 'yaṁ daśagrīvo bhaviṣyati ।। 7.9.32 ॥

translations.english: Then his father, who was like his grandfather (Brahma), named him Daśagrīva, declaring that this newborn would indeed be Daśagrīva (ten-necked).

verses.sloka: तस्य त्वनन्तरं जातः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।प्रमाणाद्यस्य विपुलं प्रमाणं नेह विद्यते ।। ७.९.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tvanantaraṁ jātaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।pramāṇādyasya vipulaṁ pramāṇaṁ neha vidyate ।। 7.9.33 ॥

translations.english: After him, the immensely powerful Kumbhakarna was born, whose vast size and measure had no equal in this world.

verses.sloka: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम सञ्जज्ञे विकृतानना ।विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा कैकस्याः पश्चिमः सुतः ।। ७.९.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma sañjajñe vikṛtānanā ।vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā kaikasyāḥ paścimaḥ sutaḥ ।। 7.9.34 ॥

translations.english: Then Shurpanakha, named for her deformed face, was born, followed by Vibhishana, the righteous-souled last son of Kaikasi.

verses.sloka: तस्मिञ्जाते महासत्त्वे पुष्पवर्षं पपात ह ।। ७.९.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmiñjāte mahāsattve puṣpavarṣaṁ papāta ha ।। 7.9.35 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, when that great being (Vibhishana) was born, a shower of flowers fell.

verses.sloka: नभःस्थाने दुन्दुभयो देवानां प्राणदंस्तदा ।वाक्यं चैवान्तरिक्षे च साधु साध्विति तत्तदा ।। ७.९.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: nabhaḥsthāne dundubhayo devānāṁ prāṇadaṁstadā ।vākyaṁ caivāntarikṣe ca sādhu sādhviti tattadā ।। 7.9.36 ॥

translations.english: Then, drums of the gods sounded in the sky, and a voice from the heavens exclaimed, "Excellent! Excellent!"

verses.sloka: तौ तु तत्र महारण्ये ववृधाते महौजसौ ।कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ लोकोद्वेगकरौ तदा ।। ७.९.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tau tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhāte mahaujasau ।kumbhakarṇadaśagrīvau lokodvegakarau tadā ।। 7.9.37 ॥

translations.english: Then, those two, Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, grew up in that great forest, becoming exceedingly powerful and a cause of distress to the world.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णः प्रमत्तस्तु महर्षीन्धर्मवत्सलान् ।त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयन्नित्यासन्तुष्टो विचचार ह ।। ७.९.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇaḥ pramattastu maharṣīndharmavatsalān ।trailokyaṁ bhakṣayannityāsantuṣṭo vicacāra ha ।। 7.9.38 ॥

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, reckless and ever unsatisfied, roamed about, devouring great sages devoted to dharma and causing havoc in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मे व्यवस्थितः ।स्वाध्यायनियताहार उवास विजितेन्द्रियः ।। ७.९.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā nityaṁ dharme vyavasthitaḥ ।svādhyāyaniyatāhāra uvāsa vijitendriyaḥ ।। 7.9.39 ॥

translations.english: In contrast, Vibhishana, a righteous soul, always remained steadfast in dharma, living with self-study, a controlled diet, and mastery over his senses.

verses.sloka: अथ वैश्रवणो देवस्तत्र कालेन केनचित् ।आगतः पितरं द्रष्टुं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः ।। ७.९.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: atha vaiśravaṇo devastatra kālena kenacit ।āgataḥ pitaraṁ draṣṭuṁ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ ।। 7.9.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, the god Vaishravana, the lord of wealth, came there in his Pushpaka chariot to see his father.

verses.sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा कैकसी तत्र ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।आगम्य राक्षसी तत्र दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ।। ७.९.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā kaikasī tatra jvalantamiva tejasā ।āgamya rākṣasī tatra daśagrīvamuvāca ha ।। 7.9.41 ॥

translations.english: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.

verses.sloka: पुत्र वैश्रवणं पश्य भ्रातरं तेजसा वृतम् ।भ्रातृभावे समे चापि पश्यात्मानं त्वमीदृशम् ।। ७.९.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: putra vaiśravaṇaṁ paśya bhrātaraṁ tejasā vṛtam ।bhrātṛbhāve same cāpi paśyātmānaṁ tvamīdṛśam ।। 7.9.42 ॥

translations.english: "O son, behold your brother Vaishravana, endowed with splendor, and even though you are equal in brotherhood, behold yourself in such a state."

verses.sloka: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम ।यथा त्वमसि मे पुत्र भव र्वैश्रवणोपमः ।। ७.९.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīva tathā yatnaṁ kuruṣvāmitavikrama ।yathā tvamasi me putra bhava rvaiśravaṇopamaḥ ।। 7.9.43 ॥

translations.english: "O Dashagriva, O one of immeasurable valor, make such an effort, my son, so that you become equal to Vaishravana."

verses.sloka: मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् ।अमर्षमतुलं लेभे प्रतिज्ञां चाकरोत्तदा ।। ७.९.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: mātustadvacanaṁ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।amarṣamatulaṁ lebhe pratijñāṁ cākarottadā ।। 7.9.44 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that speech of his mother, the valorous Dashagriva felt unequalled indignation and then made a vow.

verses.sloka: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि भ्रातृतुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा ।भविष्याम्योजसा चैव सन्तापं त्यज हृद्गतम् ।। ७.९.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi bhrātṛtulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā ।bhaviṣyāmyojasā caiva santāpaṁ tyaja hṛdgatam ।। 7.9.45 ॥

translations.english: "Truly, I promise you that I shall become either equal to or even superior to my brother in might; therefore, abandon the sorrow residing in your heart."

verses.sloka: ततस्तेनैव कोपेन दशग्रीवः सहानुजः ।चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म तपसे धृतमानसः ।। ७.९.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastenaiva kopena daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ ।cikīrṣurduṣkaraṁ karma tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ ।। 7.9.46 ॥

translations.english: Then, filled with that very anger, Dashagriva, along with his younger brothers, set his mind on performing a difficult penance.

verses.sloka: प्राप्स्यामि तपसा काममिति कृत्वा ऽध्यवस्य च ।आगच्छदात्मसिद्ध्यर्थं गोकर्णस्याश्रमं शुभम् ।। ७.९.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāpsyāmi tapasā kāmamiti kṛtvā 'dhyavasya ca ।āgacchadātmasiddhyarthaṁ gokarṇasyāśramaṁ śubham ।। 7.9.47 ॥

translations.english: Having resolved that he would achieve his desires through penance, he then came to the auspicious hermitage of Gokarna for the accomplishment of his own purpose.

verses.sloka: स राक्षसस्तत्र सहानुजस्तदा तपश्चकारातुलमुग्रविक्रमः ।अतोषयच्चापि पितामहं विभुं ददौ स तुष्टश्च वराञ्जयावहान् ।। ७.९.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rākṣasastatra sahānujastadā tapaścakārātulamugravikramaḥ ।atoṣayaccāpi pitāmahaṁ vibhuṁ dadau sa tuṣṭaśca varāñjayāvahān ।। 7.9.48 ।।

translations.english: That demon of fierce prowess, along with his younger brothers, then performed incomparable penance there, and he also pleased the lord Brahma, who, being pleased, granted him boons that brought victory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवमः सर्गः ।। 9 ।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
